subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should this PR land as the narrow fresh-session mitigation now, or should maintainers pause it and require the broader reattach-first recovery design before changing the accepted-disconnect path?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and matches the existing timeout fallback, but accepted-disconnect behavior affects session state, message delivery, and side-effect semantics that automation should not choose for maintainers.

options.title: Land narrow mitigation first
options.body: Accept the existing timeout-style two-run boundary for this rare path, merge the fresh-session fix after exact-head refresh, and track reattach-first behavior in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200.

options.title: Pause for reattach-first
options.body: Hold this PR and ask for the broader wait/reattach design so accepted disconnects avoid a second model/tool execution when possible.

options.title: Split by delivery mode
options.body: Ask for a maintainer-sponsored revision that keeps recook-first for interactive CLI but uses reattach-first or no-local rerun for delivery-mode turns.

recommendation.title: Land narrow mitigation first
recommendation.body: Accept the existing timeout-style two-run boundary for this rare path, merge the fresh-session fix after exact-head refresh, and track reattach-first behavior in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200.
